name: capacity-ramp
description: Bounded capacity ramp on named volumes: 1280 MiB per file and 64 GiB per task; the full 100 GB chain still requires a POSIX capacity filesystem
notes: This profile makes the large per-file limit runnable on Docker named volumes for bounded ramps.
The scanner wall budget is fixed at 300 s per batch; measured effective scan throughput on this host is about 8 MiB/s, so one batch is capped at 1 GiB instead of the large profile 5 GiB.
Named-volume capacity is bounded by the Docker disk image; it is not a 100 GB qualification.
The full 100 GB chain needs a POSIX filesystem with two copies plus reserve, and must be executed with large-repository.
Complete AV and per-file integrity checks remain mandatory; no sampling.
